title: Agnes's Notebook
_how: Same format as case-01.json. Every item gets the same pop-in and highlight; nothing is marked differently before 'The Solution.'

items.text: Steady breeze all day: from the sea toward the land
Flags point inland; kites lean over the dunes
Rosie's balloon sailed away toward the hills
Wooden puffin prize: judges' tent at the water's edge
4 o'clock: judges out on the sand; puffin gone

items.name: Pip
items.text: kite at the top of the beach by the dunes; class: never moved

items.name: Tamsin
items.text: book stall by the car park, endless queue

items.name: Mr Penberthy
items.text: seen hurrying from the water's edge near the tent, ~4
“String snapped; kite flew out over the sea; I ran after it.”
Flags still pointing toward the hills

solution.text: A snapped kite blows inland, not out to sea. His only reason to be at the water's edge: the tent.
